description: Merge two or more PDF files into a single PDF, in the order given. Input: a list of base64-encoded PDF file contents (each max 25 MB / 500 pages). Returns a download_url for the merged PDF (link valid 24 hours), its size and page count. Costs 1 credit; 5 free calls per month.

pdfs_base64.description: The PDF files to merge, each as a base64-encoded string, in the order they should appear in the output (at least 2; each max 25 MB / 500 pages).
pdfs_base64.title: Pdfs Base64
